name: conversion-funnel
title: Conversion Funnel
description: Participant counts and conversion between consecutive stages.
usage: <ConversionFunnel stages={[{ id: "visit", label: "Visit", count: 120 }, { id: "signup", label: "Signup", count: 36 }]} />
useCases: In a store report, an analyst compares counts at the cart, checkout and purchase stages to find the biggest drop-off.
A course team compares signups, first lessons and completions. The app supplies the participant count for each stage.

models.FunnelStage: type FunnelStage = { id: string; label: string; count: number };

behavior: The stages array sets the order of the funnel. Each count is the number of participants at that stage.
